description: This Java source file defines the AddressSupport class, which manages address layout templates within the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods for loading, serializing/deserializing, and listening to global property changes related to address templates, utilizing singleton pattern and integration with OpenMRS services.

classes.name: AddressSupport
classes.description: A singleton class that manages address layout templates, listening to global property changes and integrating with OpenMRS services to load and serialize address templates.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AddressSupport, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the AddressSupport instance, sets up global property listener, loads address template, and defines special tokens.

methods.name: getDefaultLayoutFormat
methods.description: Returns the default layout format name.

methods.name: setAddressTemplate
methods.description: Sets the list of address templates.

methods.name: getAddressTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the list of address templates, loading from global property if not already set.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Determines if the property name is related to address template management.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the address template global property and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: setAddressTemplate
methods.description: Deserializes XML into an AddressTemplate object and updates the list of templates.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Clears address templates if the related global property is deleted.
